title: Lagarde: Might consider role at WEF after ECB exit
summary: Christine Lagarde hinted at the possibility of embracing a leadership role at the World Economic Forum in the future, but clarified that her current dedication remains with the European Central Bank presidency until February 7. She also dismissed any rumors concerning her future plans, having recently announced her early departure from the ECB, which was initially set to last eight years.

title: India on track to hit $1 trillion exports target in FY27: Commerce Secretary
summary: India's exports increased by 16.6% in the first half of this fiscal year. The country aims to reach $1 trillion in exports by 2026-27. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal stated that India is on track to meet this goal. Despite global trade uncertainties, India continues to be viewed positively as a trusted trading partner. India achieved record exports of $863 billion in the previous fiscal year.
